stimulus.title: Exercício C1: Library Services (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement about a change to library services.

Speaker: Attention, students. Starting next Monday, the Main Library's third-floor reading room will be closed for renovation through the end of the month. During this period you can use the East Wing reading room instead, which keeps its regular hours. Reserved study rooms originally booked for the third floor have already been transferred automatically to the East Wing — you don't need to rebook. However, if your reservation was for a room with audiovisual equipment, please double-check availability, since not all East Wing rooms are equipped. Questions go to the circulation desk.

prompt: Detail. What happens to previously reserved study rooms?

options.A: They are canceled and must be rebooked
options.B: They are automatically transferred to the East Wing
options.C: They stay on the third floor
options.D: They are honored only if confirmed by email

explanation: "Transferred automatically to the East Wing — you don't need to rebook." (A) é o oposto; (D) adiciona uma condição não dita.

stimulus.title: Exercício C2: Course Registration (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement about course registration.

Speaker: A reminder to all second-year students: registration for spring courses opens this Thursday at 8 a.m. and closes the following Wednesday at midnight. Register early — popular courses fill within hours. If a course you need is full, add yourself to the waitlist rather than emailing the instructor; the system releases spots automatically as students drop, and it works strictly in waitlist order. One change this year: the add/drop period after classes begin has been shortened from two weeks to one, so finalize your schedule before the term starts, not after.

prompt: Detail. What should a student do if a course is full?

options.A: Email the instructor to ask for a spot
options.B: Register for a different course permanently
options.C: Add themselves to the waitlist
options.D: Wait until the add/drop period

explanation: "Add yourself to the waitlist rather than emailing the instructor." (A) é explicitamente desaconselhado.

stimulus.title: Exercício C3: Campus Event (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement about a career event.

Speaker: The annual Career Fair takes place next Wednesday from 10 to 4 in the main gymnasium. Over eighty employers will attend, mostly in engineering, healthcare, and education. A few reminders. Bring several printed copies of your résumé — most recruiters still expect a paper copy. Business-casual dress is recommended, not required. The résumé-review station near the entrance will be open from 9, an hour before the fair, and it operates first-come, first-served, so arrive early if you want feedback before talking to employers. Finally, the 9:30 workshop on interview skills is now full; a recording will be posted next week for those who missed it.

prompt: Detail. What time does the Career Fair itself begin?

options.A: 9 a.m.
options.D: 4 p.m.

explanation: "From 10 to 4." (A) é a abertura da estação de revisão de currículo; (B) é o workshop.

stimulus.title: Exercício C4: Biology Lab (meta de 1 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement at the end of a biology class.

Instructor: Okay, everyone, before you pack up, just a quick change for Friday's lab. We're not meeting in Room 204 this week. Instead, we'll meet directly at the campus greenhouse, right behind the science building. Because we're only observing plant samples and sketching them, you don't need to bring your lab coats or safety goggles this time. Just bring your field notebook and a pencil. Oh, and please be there by ten o'clock sharp, because the greenhouse staff will lock the side door right after we start.

prompt: Detail. What should students bring to Friday's class?

options.A: A field notebook and a pencil for sketching
options.B: A white lab coat and a pair of safety goggles
options.C: A set of plant samples from the science building
options.D: A key card to unlock the greenhouse side door

explanation: O instrutor avisa que a atividade será observar e desenhar plantas, por isso pede apenas caderno de campo e lápis: "Just bring your field notebook and a pencil." Um ponto de atenção é (B), que junta dois itens citados no áudio, mas o professor diz justamente que você não precisa trazê-los desta vez.

stimulus.title: Exercício C5: Dormitory Laundry Room (meta de 1 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement from a resident advisor in a student dormitory.

Resident Advisor: Hi, everyone. I just wanted to let you know that our basement laundry room will be closed all weekend, starting Friday at six p.m. Facilities is installing new card readers on the machines, so you won't need coins anymore starting Monday. If you need to wash clothes on Saturday or Sunday, you can use the laundry room in Maple Hall next door. Your student ID card will open their side entrance. Also, please clear out any clothes left in the basement before Friday evening, or the crew will move them to the front desk.

prompt: Gist-purpose. What is the main purpose of the announcement?

options.A: To explain a permanent increase in dormitory laundry prices
options.B: To welcome new residents moving into Maple Hall this week
options.C: To remind students to pick up their new student ID cards
options.D: To inform residents about a temporary laundry room closure

explanation: O objetivo central do aviso é informar que a lavanderia do prédio ficará fechada no fim de semana para uma atualização: "our basement laundry room will be closed all weekend." A opção (C) pode atrair porque o cartão de estudante é citado, mas ele serve apenas para abrir a porta do prédio vizinho, sem emissão de um cartão novo.

stimulus.title: Exercício C6: Intramural Soccer Sign-Ups (meta de 1 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement at the campus recreation center.

Coordinator: Attention, everyone! If you're planning to play in the campus soccer league this fall, remember that registration closes this Friday at five p.m. Each team needs at least seven players on its roster. Now, if you want to play but don't have a full group of friends to form a team, don't worry. You can still sign up by yourself as an individual player on the rec center website, and we'll place you on a team that needs extra people. The game schedule comes out on Monday morning, and matches start next Wednesday evening.

prompt: Detail. What should a student without a full team do to join the league?

options.A: Wait until the game schedule comes out on Monday morning
options.B: Register as an individual player on the rec center website
options.C: Show up at the soccer field on Wednesday evening at five
options.D: Ask the coordinator to lower the seven-player requirement

explanation: Para quem não tem um grupo completo, a solução está no meio da fala: "You can still sign up by yourself as an individual player on the rec center website, and we'll place you on a team." A alternativa (A) traz um horário real do áudio, mas esperar até segunda faria você perder o prazo de inscrição na sexta-feira.

stimulus.title: Exercício C7: Geology Field Trip (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement in an introductory geology class.

Professor: Before we dive into today's lecture on sediment transport, let's go over the logistics for Saturday's field trip to the Miller River Basin. The department buses will leave from the North Parking Lot at 7:30 a.m. sharp, and we should be back on campus by four. The trip counts for fifteen percent of your course grade, so attendance is expected. That said, I know a few of you work weekend shifts off campus. If you have a documented work conflict, you need to email our teaching assistant, David, by Wednesday afternoon. He'll set you up with an alternative assignment analyzing river-flow datasets from last year's survey, which carries the exact same weight. Just don't wait until Friday to tell us, or we won't be able to excuse the absence.

prompt: Detail. What must students with a weekend work conflict do by Wednesday?

options.A: Reserve a seat on the late bus leaving from the North Parking Lot
options.B: Collect sediment samples from the river basin on their own time
options.C: Contact the teaching assistant to request an alternative project
options.D: Submit last year's river-flow survey before the Friday lecture

explanation: Se você trabalha no fim de semana, o professor orienta a avisar o monitor até quarta-feira para receber a atividade substitutiva: "you need to email our teaching assistant, David, by Wednesday afternoon. He'll set you up with an alternative assignment." A opção (D) confunde o prazo de avisar a ausência com a entrega da análise de dados.

stimulus.title: Exercício C8: Campus Flu Clinic (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement from Student Health Services.

Speaker: Hi, everyone. Next Tuesday and Wednesday, Student Health Services will be hosting our annual flu shot clinic in the Student Union Ballroom, from nine a.m. to four p.m. both days. Notice that we've split the schedule this year to cut down on long lines: between nine and noon, anyone can walk in without an appointment, but from one to four p.m., we're only taking students who booked a time slot online through the health portal. The vaccine is free if you're covered by the university health plan, though you still need to bring your student ID card. If you're on a private family insurance plan instead, please upload a photo of your insurance card to the portal at least twenty-four hours before you come in, so our staff doesn't have to process paperwork at the door.

prompt: Detail. Why did Student Health Services divide the clinic schedule into two parts?

options.A: To reduce waiting times at the Student Union Ballroom
options.B: To separate undergraduate students from graduate staff
options.C: To reserve morning hours for private insurance holders
options.D: To give the nursing staff a three-hour break for lunch

explanation: O motivo de dividir o atendimento entre manhã livre e tarde agendada aparece logo no início: "we've split the schedule this year to cut down on long lines." A expressão cut down on long lines equivale a reduzir o tempo de fila. Já (C) mistura a regra da manhã com a exigência do plano de saúde privado, que vem só no final.

A opção (A) falha porque à tarde não há encaixe sem hora marcada.

stimulus.title: Exercício C9: Midterm Review Session (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement at the beginning of a political science lecture.

Professor: Good morning, everyone. Before we start, I need to make two adjustments to this week's schedule. I'm flying to Chicago on Thursday morning to present a paper at a conference, which means I won't be in my office for my usual Thursday afternoon hours. Instead, I'll hold extended office hours tomorrow — that's Wednesday — from two to five p.m. on Zoom; the link is already on the course page. As for Friday's class, we're still meeting in this room at our regular time, because my teaching assistant, Clara, will run a midterm review session. She'll walk you through two sample essay questions from past exams and show you how we use the grading rubric. Keep in mind, though, that she won't be reviewing individual study outlines during class, so save specific questions like that for my Zoom hours tomorrow.

prompt: Detail. How can students meet with the professor this week?

options.A: By visiting her office on Thursday afternoon as usual
options.B: By staying in the lecture hall after Friday's review
options.C: By booking a private meeting with Clara on Wednesday
options.D: By joining her online office hours on Wednesday afternoon

explanation: Como a professora viajará na quinta, ela antecipou o atendimento para quarta à tarde, pela internet: "Instead, I'll hold extended office hours tomorrow, that's Wednesday, from two to five p.m. on Zoom." Um ponto de atenção é (A), que repete o horário habitual de quinta justamente quando ela avisa que não estará lá.

stimulus.title: Exercício C10: Research Poster Symposium (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement for students participating in the Undergraduate Research Symposium.

Speaker: Thanks for coming to this brief orientation, everyone. With the Undergraduate Research Symposium just two weeks away, I want to highlight a critical deadline regarding your posters. The university print shop is covering the cost of printing one large-format poster per presenter, provided you upload your final PDF to the symposium portal by this Friday at five p.m. Now, make sure your faculty advisor signs off on the layout before you upload it, because the print shop won't accept revised files once a job is in the queue. If you miss Friday's cutoff, you aren't disqualified from presenting, but you'll have to have your poster printed at a commercial shop at your own expense. Finally, on the day of the symposium, you're only required to stand by your board during your assigned one-hour judging window; the rest of the afternoon, you're free to view other students' work.

prompt: Function. Why does the speaker urge students to get their advisor's approval before uploading their file?

options.A: Because faculty advisors must upload the PDF files through their own accounts
options.B: Because the print shop does not allow replacement files after submission
options.C: Because the symposium judges grade the advisor's comments on the layout
options.D: Because commercial print shops charge extra for unapproved poster designs

explanation: O orientador precisa aprovar a versão antes do envio porque a gráfica universitária não aceita trocar o arquivo depois que ele entra na fila: "make sure your faculty advisor signs off on the layout before you upload it, because the print shop won't accept revised files once a job is in the queue." A alternativa (A) distorce o processo, pois quem envia o arquivo no portal é você mesmo, não o orientador.

stimulus.title: Exercício C11: Honors Thesis Deposit (meta de 2 min)
stimulus.content:
Narrator: Listen to an announcement from the director of the senior honors program.

Director: Congratulations on reaching the final stretch of your senior honors theses. As you prepare for next month's oral defenses, please take note of an important policy update from the university archives. Starting this term, the library has phased out physical bound copies altogether; your final deposit will consist solely of a PDF submitted to the institutional repository. By default, every thesis uploaded to that repository becomes publicly searchable worldwide as soon as degrees are conferred in June. For most of you, having your work openly accessible is a plus. However, if your thesis incorporates unpublished data from your advisor's lab that is slated for submission to a peer-reviewed journal, premature public release could jeopardize that publication, since some journals consider an open thesis a prior publication. In that case, you and your advisor must file an embargo form at the time of upload, which restricts public access for up to two years.

prompt: Detail. How has the library's thesis submission policy changed this term?

options.A: Students must now schedule their oral defense before June graduation
options.B: The institutional repository now restricts all theses for two years
options.C: Printed bound volumes have been replaced by a digital-only deposit
options.D: Faculty advisors are no longer required to sign the final upload form

explanation: A mudança deste semestre é o fim das cópias impressas encadernadas, substituídas pelo envio apenas em PDF: "Starting this term, the library has phased out physical bound copies altogether; your final deposit will consist solely of a PDF." O phrasal verb phase out quer dizer extinguir gradualmente. Já (B) generaliza a restrição de dois anos, que vale só para quem pede o embargo.
